name: Diphenpipenol
summary: Diphenpipenol is an opioid analgesic drug invented in the 1970s by Dainippon Pharmaceutical Co. It is chemically a 1-substituted-4-(1,2-diphenylethyl)piperazine derivative related to compounds such as MT-45 and AD-1211, but diphenpipenol is the most potent compound in the series, with the more active (S) enantiomer being around 105 times the potency of morphine in animal studies.

pharmacology.text: Diphenpipenol has been offered for sale online as a designer drug, though analysis of a sample of supposed diphenpipenol found it to instead contain a structural isomer with much weaker opioid activity, and it is unclear if genuine diphenpipenol has actually been sold.

uses.text: Diphenpipenol has been offered for sale online as a designer drug, though analysis of a sample of supposed diphenpipenol found it to instead contain a structural isomer with much weaker opioid activity, and it is unclear if genuine diphenpipenol has actually been sold.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Strong opioids like it can cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的影響所知甚少。與它同類的強效鴉片類藥物可能造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的影响所知甚少。与它同类的强效鸦片类药物可能造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。

fact.en: Like MT-45, it belongs to the 1,2-diphenylethylpiperazine family, a group of opioids that look quite unlike morphine yet act on the same receptor.
fact.zh: Diphenpipenol與MT-45同屬1,2-二苯乙基哌嗪家族，這類鴉片類藥物的結構與嗎啡差異很大，卻作用於相同的受體。
fact.zhHans: Diphenpipenol与MT-45同属1,2-二苯乙基哌嗪家族，这类鸦片类药物的结构与吗啡差异很大，却作用于相同的受体。
